description: Score options against criteria when the score matrix is supplied separately. Returns the full normalized scored matrix + ranking, without the narrative winner explanation.

criteria.description: Weighted criteria. Each: {name, weight (relative, >=0), direction: 'benefit' (higher better, default) | 'cost' (lower better)}.

options.description: Named alternatives. Strings or {name, scores} objects.

scores.description: Score matrix. {"Option A": {"Criterion 1": 8, ...}, ...} or array form or inline on options.

name: score_options
